expertiseSources.summary: Defines observable behavior assertions, test-level selection, isolation, deterministic boundaries, and meaningful regression evidence.

exception.rationale: The streamlined workflow explicitly requires an observed expected red step before production implementation, rejects vacuous or weakened assertions, and limits exceptions to authorized nonbehavioral work. It preserves surrounding and repository-required gates instead of equating a focused pass with complete correctness. This requests a regression-safety exception; no measured output-quality gain or completed human approval is claimed.
